question: How does he abide, desirous of emitting beings?
premises: Having established the supreme goddess, this one abides self-surpassed.
Thus desirous of emitting beings, from the emitter-state.
inference: Goddess established, he abides self-surpassed and turns toward emission.
uncertainties: Nyakkṛtya read as established against cast-down.
The emitter-state clause closed with the next verse.
plain_english: Having established the supreme goddess, this one abides, surpassed in himself; thus, desirous of emitting beings, from the state of the emitter.
